text: I used to frequent this clinic. For a while, the male dentist was very nice, but he was only available on weekdays. When I tried to go on a Sunday without an appointment (understandable given the crowd), I waited for about two hours. The female dentist, who seemed to be the owner, was terrible. During the examination, she refused to treat my teeth, saying my jaw was clicking and causing locking. She spoke in a high-pitched voice. I was so confused. I told her my jaw wasn't locked, and she just told me to come back another day (I was in tooth pain!). There was another patient waiting for my examination, and instead of just saying she was busy, she made me wait. She then made up some stupid excuse. I ended up at another clinic and they treated me normally. This clinic is insane. Anyone considering this clinic should run away. It's ridiculous.

text: I had a filling and it wasn't done well, so I couldn't chew food since it was done. I actually intended to get another tooth filled, that is, the neck of my tooth filled. But after the doctor checked, he said I had a cavity. So I told him to do it all at once since I was already here. But it turned out that it took more than an hour to finish, and he even ripped my mouth open. And the tooth I intended to have fixed wasn't fixed. In the end, my whole mouth was damaged. I couldn't chew food. My mouth was torn and sore for a week. The cost was a little over 1700 baht. In the end, the filled tooth had to be removed because the filling went wrong. I had to spend money to do it again and I didn't dare go to the original doctor. I was really scared. I changed to a clinic that might be a bit more expensive, but the quality is much better. P.S. The staff member who looks like a tomboy is the worst. She acts like someone asking to get it done for free. I heard that you have to pay to do it.
